name: io.file.mixin
description: Loads a static file, applies same-named Hyperlambda codebehind, and returns the mixed result

input.description: Path to the static file to mix with its same-named .hl codebehind file

*.description: Optional argument available to codebehind lambda loaded for the mixed file

output.description: Resolves to the mixed file content in value and any codebehind-produced child nodes
